steps.label: 1695-source-validation-empty-submit
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/product/form.donga')throw Error('Create form scope mismatch');const f=document.querySelector('form[action="/product/create.donga"]');if(!f||f.querySelector('[name=curriculum]').value||f.querySelector('[name=classType]').value)throw Error('Expected empty required selectors');const valid=f.checkValidity();if(valid)throw Error('Empty form unexpectedly valid; stop before submit');[...f.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='저장').click();return {action:'Click actual Save on invalid blank registration form',validBefore:valid};})()

steps.label: 1701-source-validation-cancel
command: (() => {const f=document.querySelector('form[action="/product/create.donga"]');const a=[...f.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='취소');if(!a)throw Error('Observed Cancel link absent');const href=a.getAttribute('href');a.click();return {action:'Click form Cancel after local edits',href};})()
